hints.title: Track Previous 1 Index
hints.text: Maintain the index of the most recently encountered 1.

hints.title: Distance Verification
hints.text: When a new 1 is found at index i, check if i - prev_idx - 1 < k. If so, return false.

hints.title: Single Linear Pass
hints.text: Update prev_idx to i and continue scanning until the end of the array. If no violation occurs, return true.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning forward k elements from every 1 takes O(N * K) worst case.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Remembering only the last seen 1 index achieves single-pass O(N) time and O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate maintains previous 1 index and checks gap constraint.
complexity.notes: Initial prev index can be set to -infinity.
